about: Intro track IN-4, the way back: the first run's end. After the Bureau's pickup (story.json pickup-won, pickup-lost) and the fall from its square portal (opening-fall.js fallPlay from 'portal'), you wake outside Professor Chosen's lab: he runs out, Kappi follows, you make yourself up, Kappi tallies what you brought back (the payout sheet) and the two of them explain expeditions. Then the hub. Played by cutscene/return-scene.js; filmed on the opening's set (its spots, shots and clear are the opening's: tools/build-copperleaf.mjs keeps them the same).
script: [surprised] Chosen: You came out of the sky.[p] [b]Again.[/b] Once is an accident. Twice is a [i]brand[/i]. #l:0135
Chosen: I took the next train home, by the way. First class. They gave me a blanket for the shock.[p] I wasn’t in shock. I kept the blanket. #l:88e1
Kappi: You’re outside the lab, in Copperleaf. Nothing’s broken. I checked.[p] Twice. #l:2a5d
Chosen: Before anything else: who [i]are[/i] you? Still nothing? Fine. We’ll build you from scratch.[p] Like a legend. #l:f85b
[happy] Chosen: {name}. Strong name.[p] Second-strongest on this porch. #l:b9d5
Kappi: Now, what you brought back. Empty your pockets. I’ll count. #l:04bf
Kappi: That square of light in front of the train? You came down through one just now. It’s the Bureau’s. #l:0084
[surprised] Chosen: The Bureau? Paperwork people. Don’t sign [b]anything[/b].[p] I signed one thing once. I still get letters. #l:dd9c
Chosen: Here’s the plan. Skyline Station, just up the hill. Its trains go out past the island, to wild places nobody’s mapped. #l:c0d7
Kappi: Every trip is a new region. New Billies, new leaders. You never get the same one twice. #l:d777
Kappi: What you catch can come home with you. What you learn turns into Research, for the lab. That stays, whatever happens out there. #l:1c6e
[happy] Chosen: And every trip, you come back stronger. Like a training montage.[p] I [i]love[/i] a montage. #l:14c0
Kappi: Rest first. The station isn’t going anywhere.[p] Neither are we. #l:20d9
